turns.text: I teach year nine and I'm showing a film on the last day of term. Help me pick.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Listen to all of them first, then comment.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: One is an underdog sports film about a tiny school basketball team that ends up in the finals.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: There's also a space survival story where an astronaut gets stranded and has to solve problems with science.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Or a courtroom drama about a teenager wrongly accused, which could start a good discussion.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Okay, that's all. Which sounds best to you?

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Last day energy is usually low and chatty. I'd go with the space survival film, it's gripping without being heavy. Keep the courtroom drama for a normal lesson where you can discuss it properly.
